plan: Drive: from City of Prince George, about 37 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Carney St, Hwy 16, Blackwater Rd, Jeanie Road FSR.
Park: 53.69967, -122.95935, pull off on Amend 62 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the unnamed road stretch, 3.7 km one way. About 74 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-10, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 31 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
